name: Mayu Ichinose
source:
Dorm: White Lilies
Rank: Expert

A member of the White Lilies who is very much in love with the protagonist to the extent that she admits to being his stalker, which is helped by the fact that her Talent allows her to become invisible, and is very open with how she feels about him.
